batches.interpretation: Auto decisions: Pro passed; Flash omitted the release operation. A valid explicit old-superseded plus replacement batch was also initially rejected and subsequently supported.
Same resource limits with clearer operation rules: Flash passed; Pro omitted release. Entire batch remains failed.
Explicit JSON release parameters: both released correctly. Flash omitted the last persisted update; Pro did not meet strict JSON recall output. Entire batch remains failed.
Current-input boundary, output-format rule and stronger persisted-update oracle: Pro passed; Flash first call had model_network_error.
Flash-only manual revalidation: guessed invisible citation, then history reads used the bounded steps without finishing corrections; compaction was omitted. Remains failed.
Flash-only bounded source/field/ID feedback: all eight turns and actual mutations passed under auto.
Pro-only revalidation with feedback: last update omitted despite a successful final reply; persisted-update oracle correctly failed the case.
Both profiles explicitly configured required decisions, thinking disabled; final remains none. Same 24576/20000ms/4/8/30 limits. Both eight-turn cases passed.

upstream_protocol_reference.verified_scope: required is supported in non-thinking mode and leaves tool selection to the model; thinking mode does not support required.

counter_semantics.scope_turn_counts_in_batch_observations: Describe the complete planned case; actual rounds and imported fixtures are recorded per case/additional evidence. The failed first-network-call case imported no filler.
counter_semantics.all_batches_preserved: Different code, prompt/oracle and decision-protocol checkpoints are not merged into one success rate.
counter_semantics.final_batch: Both profiles passed in one batch with identical final resource policy and required decisions.
counter_semantics.tool_selection: required constrains native action format only. prepare_response remains available; the main model chooses business semantics and tools.
counter_semantics.semantic_checks: Strict JSON plus persisted updates and actual model request observations; a correct answer alone does not prove a write.
counter_semantics.usage: Provider-reported completed recorded calls only; cancelled/network-failed calls may have unreported billed usage.
counter_semantics.input_capacity: Serialized UTF-8 engineering estimates, not exact provider tokenizer counts.
